name: Bogor Palace
scope: The standing Bogor Palace in West Java, comprising the central white palace and its two connected wing ranges and porticos.
era: The current palace reconstructed in the nineteenth century with the standing exterior as photographed in 2007.

references.caption: The Presidential Palace in Bogor, Indonesia
references.alt: The Presidential Palace in Bogor, Indonesia

originalReview.notes: The exact photographer-dedicated Qualla photo establishes the white colonnade and triangular pediment, layered plinth, terracotta roof and golden metal cupola on a tall white drum.

review.method: Exact Qualla photographer-dedicated exterior, named mapped palace and official written history
review.notes: The exact current Davidelit photograph documents the central ceremonial portico, red roof and gilded central cupola. The named current mapped building resolves both lateral ranges and connecting galleries. The stamp and garden images are excluded from the reconstruction.
